info.description:
The dimos server's HTTP API: blueprints, global config, runs and their logs, events, Dimensional cloud uploads.

dimOS Desktop starts the server (`python -m dimos.server`, on a unix socket) and forwards `/dimos/...` to it unchanged.
Every answer is JSON unless the operation says otherwise; every error is `{"error": "<message>"}` (ErrorResponse).
State is HTTP; changes are events, published on zenoh at `<ns>/dimos/events/<type>` (the `events` tag).

Extensions: `x-family: dimos` on every operation; `x-agent: true` marks what Desktop's agent finds through
search_endpoints; `x-mcp-tool` names an MCP tool that does the same; `x-zenoh-key` on an event schema is its key.
info.title: dimos server

tags.description: The server itself: liveness, the checkout it serves, where things are, stopping it. Desktop asks `GET /dimos/paths` whether a running server serves the checkout in its config.yaml, and stops one that serves another.
tags.name: server

tags.description: What dimos can run. The list is read in the server's process (cached 60 s; `?fresh=1` refills it). A blueprint's modules, config and the catalog import blueprint code, so they run in a child process with a 180 s timeout and are cached 10 min: the first call can take seconds.
tags.name: blueprints

tags.description: dimos's GlobalConfig (robot_ip, simulation, n_workers, ...) and Desktop's saved overrides (config.yaml `dimos.global_config`), which become `--key value` flags on every launch.
tags.name: global-config

tags.description: Launching and stopping blueprints. `POST /dimos/runs` runs `dimos [--key value ...] run <blueprint>` in the checkout, in its own session (it outlives the server), output to launch.log. One launch at a time: a second is refused while the first is starting or running. Its phase (starting, running, stopped, failed) is worked out from dimos's run registry and the pid on every call. Stopping sends the process group SIGINT, then SIGTERM after 20 s, then SIGKILL after 10 more.
tags.name: runs

tags.description: A run's structured log (`<logs>/<run_id>/main.jsonl`), read off disk. Tail it by passing the answer's `offset` back as `after`. Warning-or-worse records of the current launch are also `log` events.
tags.name: logs

tags.description: This machine's Dimensional cloud login: dimos's device flow (`dimos login`). Start it, show the URL and code, and the user approves it in any signed-in browser; `cloud-login` events (or polling `GET /dimos/cloud/login`) follow it.
tags.name: cloud

tags.description: Uploading recordings to Dimensional cloud with dimos's own code, one at a time, first in first out. The queue survives a restart (an interrupted upload resumes). With no login an upload goes back to the front and `waitingForLogin` turns true until a login is approved. `upload`, `uploads` and `upload-removed` events follow it.
tags.name: uploads

tags.description: The server's events, each a JSON object with a `type`: `launch`, `log`, `upload`, `uploads`, `upload-removed`, `cloud-login` (schemas: DimosEvent). They are published on zenoh at `<ns>/dimos/events/<type>` (Desktop's docs/events.md; `<ns>` is Desktop's namespace), which is where to listen. The SSE stream `GET /dimos/events` carries the same events and is deprecated (kept one release).
